raw_response: {"diagnosis": "From 2026-01-17 the source sends a reversal as a separate REVERSAL record with orig_txn_id and no longer updates the original, which stays POSTED. silver_transactions only filters status='POSTED', so reversed originals are still counted and gold totals run high for recent days. The fix is to exclude POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL record, which matches how the old REVERSED status behaved.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id)"}}
